title: Cloud Networking Concepts: The Complete Beginner's Guide

scenes.narration: Think of the cloud as a shared office building. Your floor is private, though the building is shared. That's how cloud networking works.

scenes.heading: The shared building
scenes.narration: A few models and terms organise the cloud. Public, private, hybrid and community are the four deployment models. I a a S, P a a S and S a a S are the three service models. You control less as you move from I a a S to S a a S. A V P C is your isolated network inside the cloud.

scenes.heading: Common mix-ups
scenes.narration: Three traps. I a a S gives most control. Hybrid mixes cloud with on premises. It's a logical network.

scenes.heading: Remember this
scenes.cta: Try the Courseiva cloud networking lab
scenes.narration: So, to recap. Four deployment models, three service models. Control falls from I a a S to S a a S. A V P C is a private logical network. Ready to practise? Try the Courseiva cloud networking lab.
